build_actor_critic_model: build a Model_ActorCritic instance with args to initialize the MiniRTSNet trunk and policy/value heads
run_forward_pass: run the forward method on Model_ActorCritic with state dict x to get policy and value outputs
test_transition_model: test the transition method to predict future hidden states given current state h and action a
review_decision_method: review the decision method that computes softmax policy and value from hidden representation h
refactor_reset_forward: refactor the reset_forward method to reinitialize Wt, Wt2, Wt3 transition model linear layer parameters
